Subject: Post-signature MAP: deployment sprint chronicle & acceptance checkpoints — Helixera

Hi Jason / Suhas —

Thanks again for getting the contract over the finish line. Attached is the mutual action plan (MAP_v1.3.xlsx) that embeds our post-signature implementation plan: rollout cadence, canary windows, migration checkpoints, and the training schedule for both infra & product teams. Key highlights up front: 

- Canary window proposed: weekend of Sep 11–12 (UTC), with a single-hour ramp at 02:00–03:00 UTC on Day 1.
- Migration cutover target: Sep 18–19 nightly batch window with a daytime verification on Sep 20.
- Training: two 90-minute sessions for Helixera SRE + App teams (recording & lab exercises included) on Sep 7 and Sep 14.
- Acceptance checklist: we included an Acceptance_Sheet.pdf to record sign-off per milestone.

Please confirm the canary weekend works for your on-call rotation and whether the Sep 7 training can be moved later in the week if needed. If all looks good we’ll lock the MAP and circulate the action-assignee list (owners + deadlines).

Attachments: MAP_v1.3.xlsx (MAP + embedded eval plan), Runbook_Snippet.docx (canary run steps), Acceptance_Sheet.pdf (sign-off template)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Jason / Kimberly —

Super helpful notes, Jason. Quick responses and an updated, pragmatic suggestion set from the delivery side: 

- Canary ramp shift: We can move the peak ramp to 04:00–05:00 UTC. The pre-warm sequence will be shortened by 30 minutes (we’ll increase cache warm parallelism to compensate). No change to risk profile expected.
- Training: Sep 9 (Thursday) works for Redwood trainers — we’ll run the first live workshop Sep 9 and the follow-up hands-on lab on Sep 14 as planned.
- Rollback criteria: we’ll add an inline summary to the Acceptance_Sheet with these threshold bullets:
  * sustained 5xx rate > 2% for > 10 minutes
  * latency (p95) increase > 300ms baseline for > 15 minutes
  * KV cache miss surge > 40% sustained during traffic shift

Action items (owners / deadlines):
- Ben Carter: finalize canary runbook v1.1 and update MAP (due Aug 23)
- Grace O'Connor: schedule training invites + lab environment (due Aug 25)
- Jason Patel: confirm on-call list and procurement requirements (due Aug 20)

I’ve attached a short Runbook_Snippet.docx and will push a MAP update by Monday. Once Jason confirms procurement items we’ll circulate the Acceptance_Sheet for signature.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
